dataset_name: TDS evidence review -- new targeted synthetic challenge set
purpose: Challenge the frozen 16-case development baseline; crafted after source-code review, so not an unbiased independent holdout
labeling: Fact-status labels reflect an unvalidated reading of the synthetic excerpts; no legal accuracy claim

cases.invoice_description: Monthly service charge for equipment technicians.
cases.contract_excerpt: Agency makes five technicians available to the Purchaser. Payroll and annual leave are managed by Agency. Throughout each shift, each technician is instructed and supervised by the Purchaser site manager, who distributes individual repair assignments.
evidence_anchors: Throughout each shift, each technician is instructed and supervised by the Purchaser site manager, who distributes individual repair assignments.
cases.label_note: Synthetic provisional factual reading of the described control relationship; no tax-law classification is validated.

cases.invoice_description: Monthly service charge for cleaning staff.
cases.contract_excerpt: Supplier provides four cleaners at the Client offices. Daily assignments for each cleaner are issued by Supplier own on-site foreperson, who supervises the cleaning staff. Client may inspect the finished rooms but has no authority to direct any cleaner.
evidence_anchors: Daily assignments for each cleaner are issued by Supplier own on-site foreperson, who supervises the cleaning staff.
cases.label_note: Synthetic provisional factual reading of the described control relationship; no tax-law classification is validated.

cases.invoice_description: Monthly service charge for security desk staff.
cases.contract_excerpt: Provider deploys six security-desk operators to the facility. Customer receives weekly incident reports, reviews service-level metrics and may request a replacement. Neither the allocation of shifts nor the supervision of individual operators is specified.
cases.label_note: Synthetic provisional factual reading of the described control relationship; no tax-law classification is validated.

cases.invoice_description: Monthly service charge for production support staff.
cases.contract_excerpt: Vendor provides eight production assistants. Customer does not manage payroll, insurance or leave. However, Customer shift leaders directly supervise each assistant and assign daily workstation tasks.
evidence_anchors: However, Customer shift leaders directly supervise each assistant and assign daily workstation tasks.
cases.label_note: Synthetic provisional factual reading of the described control relationship; no tax-law classification is validated.

cases.invoice_description: Monthly service charge for maintenance engineers.
cases.contract_excerpt: Supplier assigns three maintenance engineers to the premises. Customer cannot direct the individual engineers. Supplier project lead alone directs their daily duties, issues their task lists, and supervises their work.
evidence_anchors: Supplier project lead alone directs their daily duties, issues their task lists, and supervises their work.
cases.label_note: Synthetic provisional factual reading of the described control relationship; no tax-law classification is validated.

cases.invoice_description: Monthly service charge for call-centre agents.
cases.contract_excerpt: Provider supplies twelve agents at the Customer office. Only after a future written addendum is signed may Customer begin supervising their individual calls. No addendum has been signed, and this agreement states no current supervision arrangement.
cases.label_note: Synthetic provisional factual reading of the described control relationship; no tax-law classification is validated.

cases.invoice_description: Monthly service charge for warehouse workers.
cases.contract_excerpt: Vendor supplies six warehouse workers to Company. Company floor manager personally directs the workers and supervises individual picking assignments each day.
evidence_anchors: Company floor manager personally directs the workers and supervises individual picking assignments each day.

cases.invoice_description: Monthly service charge for event stewards.
cases.contract_excerpt: Agency provides stewards for the event. Clause 4: Customer lead supervises the individual stewards and allocates their work. Clause 5: Agency lead alone supervises the individual stewards and allocates their work. Both clauses are current; precedence is not specified.
evidence_anchors: Customer lead supervises the individual stewards and allocates their work.
Agency lead alone supervises the individual stewards and allocates their work.

evidence_anchors: Vendor floor supervisor allocates tickets to each agent and directs their daily work.

cases.invoice_description: Monthly service charge for customer support operators.

evidence_anchors: The operative clause states: Customer team leader supervises each operator and allocates the individual tasks.
